tool_schemas.name: getRepoAllDirectories
tool_schemas.description: Returns a complete list of directory paths for the cached snapshot of the repository identified by repoUrl; results are returned as a single unpaged collection. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if repoUrl is not a valid URI, NOT_FOUND if the repository cannot be resolved or no snapshot/tree exists in cache for it, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to access the repository. May raise RATE_LIMITED if request quotas are exceeded.

repoUrl.description: The URL of the Github repo

tool_schemas.name: getRepoDirectories
tool_schemas.description: Returns the immediate children directories for the given directory path within the cached snapshot of the repository identified by repoUrl (not recursive); results are returned as a single unpaged collection. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if repoUrl is not a valid URI or path is empty/invalid, NOT_FOUND if the repository, snapshot, or the specified directory path does not exist, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to access the repository. May raise RATE_LIMITED if request quotas are exceeded.

repoUrl.description: The URL of the Github repo

tool_schemas.name: getRepoFile
tool_schemas.description: Returns the contents (and basic metadata when available) of the file at the given path within the cached snapshot of the repository identified by repoUrl. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if repoUrl is not a valid URI or path is empty/invalid, NOT_FOUND if the repository, snapshot, or file path does not exist (including when the path refers to a directory), and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to access the repository. May raise RATE_LIMITED if request quotas are exceeded.

repoUrl.description: The URL of the Github repo

tool_schemas.name: getRepository
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single cached repository record by id. Returns the repository object. Raises NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to view it.

tool_schemas.name: listRepositories
tool_schemas.description: Lists cached repositories visible to the caller, optionally filtered by repoUrl/owner/name/status. Results are paginated. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to list repositories.

repoUrl.description: Filter by an exact normalized repository URL.

visibility.description: Filter by repository visibility when known.

limit.description: Maximum number of repositories to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: createRepoSnapshot
tool_schemas.description: Ensures a snapshot indexing job exists for the repository identified by repoUrl at the requested ref. If the repository is not yet cached, it is created with status='active'. Returns the created (or reused) repo_snapshot record. Refuses with FORBIDDEN/CONFLICT when the repository is disabled/deleted, and VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid repoUrl/ref.

repoUrl.description: The URL of the Github repo to snapshot.

ref.description: Git ref to snapshot (branch, tag, or commit SHA). If omitted, uses the repository default_ref when known.

force.description: When true, enqueues a new snapshot even if a non-expired ready snapshot exists for the same ref.

tool_schemas.name: getRepoSnapshot
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single repository snapshot record by id, including its current lifecycle status and any error_message. Raises NOT_FOUND if the snapshot id does not exist, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to view it.

tool_schemas.name: listRepoSnapshots
tool_schemas.description: Lists snapshots for a repository, optionally filtered by ref/status. Results are paginated. Raises NOT_FOUND if the repository cannot be resolved, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to view snapshots.

repoUrl.description: The URL of the Github repo whose snapshots to list.

limit.description: Maximum number of snapshots to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: updateRepository
tool_schemas.description: Updates writable fields on a cached repository, including lifecycle status transitions (active/disabled/deleted) and default_ref. Returns the updated repository. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid fields, and CONFLICT if the requested status transition is not permitted.

defaultRef.description: Default git ref to use when creating snapshots (e.g., main).

status.description: Repository lifecycle status. Allowed transitions: active->disabled/deleted, disabled->active/deleted.

metadata.name: GitHub Repo MCP Server
metadata.description: This backend indexes GitHub repositories (by URL) into a lightweight content cache so directory listings and file contents can be served quickly without repeatedly calling GitHub. The main workflow is: resolve repoUrl -> ensure a snapshot of a specific ref is available -> read directories/files from
